# Kiln Heat-up and Start-up: Control Narrative Section (Module KLN)

**Document:** CN-KLN-001, Draft A, 2026-10-19
**Source:** Shift notes from the senior kiln operator (the only source). Every value not in the notes is marked "confirm" in Annex A.

**Interpretations to confirm:**
- All temperatures are °C.
- "Back end" means the kiln inlet gas temperature, TT-KLN-101.
- "ID fan 60%" means VFD speed.
- "Kill the ESP" means trip the ESP high voltage.
- "Tower hot" is defined by TT-KLN-102.

---

## 1. Purpose and boundaries

This section governs the cold start of the kiln and preheater/precalciner line from a cold, stopped condition to a handoff to normal operation. Normal operation, cool-down and normal trips are covered in other sections.

| Interface | Direction | Content |
|---|---|---|
| Coal system | In/out | Coal ready, coal feeder demand |
| Kiln feed system | Out/in | Feed demand, feed ready |
| ESP | Out | HV permit and trip |
| Emergency power | In | Source available |
| SIS | In/out | Trips executed per SRS (see 6) |

---

## 2. Equipment and tags

There is no instrument index. These tags are provisional and must be aligned to the index.

| Tag | Description |
|---|---|
| TT-KLN-101 | Back-end (kiln inlet gas) temperature |
| TT-KLN-102 | Preheater top-stage outlet temperature ("tower") |
| PT-KLN-101 | Kiln back-end draft |
| AT-KLN-101 | Kiln inlet CO analyzer |
| TI-KLN-201 | Shell scanner, maximum shell temperature, with zone |
| M-KLN-101 / M-KLN-102 | Main drive / aux drive |
| ZS-KLN-102 | Aux drive engaged feedback |
| SC-ID-101 | ID fan speed |
| BRN-101 | Main burner |
| FV-BRN-101 | Diesel valve (fail closed) |
| FIC-BRN-102 | Coal feeder rate |
| BS-BRN-101 | Flame scanner |
| FIC-KLN-101 | Kiln feed rate |
| ESP-101 | ESP high voltage |
| XS-EP-101 | Emergency power available |

---

## 3. States and transitions

| State | Entry permissives | Initiator | Automation level | Allowed exits |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ST-01 Stopped-Cold | No fuel, no feed | n/a | n/a | ST-02 |
| ST-02 Pre-start | Operator selects START-UP | Operator | Operator-prompted | ST-03, ST-08 |
| ST-03 Diesel heat-up | SQ-1 complete, flame proven | Operator (FIRE) | Ignition operator-prompted, ramp automatic | ST-04, ST-08, ST-09 |
| ST-04 Coal changeover | TT-KLN-101 at or above SP-01, coal ready, CO below SP-12 | Operator (COAL) | Operator-prompted start, automatic execution | ST-05, ST-08, ST-09 |
| ST-05 Coal heat-up | Diesel closed, coal flame proven | Auto | Automatic | ST-06, ST-08, ST-09 |
| ST-06 Feed start and ramp | Feed permissives (FR-KLN-040) | Operator (FEED) | Start operator-prompted, ramp automatic | ST-07, ST-08, ST-09 |
| ST-07 Running | Feed at operator target | Auto | Handoff to normal operation section | Out of scope |
| ST-08 Held | Operator HOLD, or auto hold | Operator/auto | Operator-prompted | Resume to the held state, ST-09 |
| ST-09 Safe (aborted) | Abort, trip, or power loss | Operator/auto | Automatic | ST-10 |
| ST-10 Restart | Power or trip cause cleared | Operator | Operator-prompted | ST-02, ST-03, ST-04, ST-06 (per FR-KLN-062) |

Kiln turning (SQ-T) runs in parallel in every state, from ST-02 until the main drive takes over.

---

## 4. Regulatory control

| Loop | PV | Output | Action | Mode behavior | Override |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TIC-KLN-101 | TT-KLN-101 | Fuel demand (FV-BRN-101 on diesel, FIC-BRN-102 on coal) | Direct: more fuel gives higher PV | AUTO follows the ramp SP. MANUAL freezes the ramp. Rate alarms stay active. | Rate override cuts fuel when the rate exceeds SP-05. Fuel is limited by ID fan speed. |
| PIC-KLN-101 | PT-KLN-101 | SC-ID-101 | Per fan design | AUTO holds draft. | Output clamped at or above SP-07 while firing. |
| FIC-KLN-101 | Feed rate | Feed device speed | Direct | AUTO follows the ramp in SQ-4. | Held at the last value on Hold. |
| SIC-KLN-101 | Main drive speed | Main drive | Direct | Fixed at SP-30 until feed starts, then per the normal operation section. | None |

---

## 5. Sequences

**Test methods:**
- **T1:** Force the transition condition true and false in simulation. Check the outputs.
- **T2:** Force the step timeout. Check the failure response.
- **T3:** Walk the HMI. Check displays and prompts.

All timeouts are in Annex A. Each step has its own FR ID.

### SQ-1 Pre-start (ST-02)

| Step / ID | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response | Test |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 / FR-KLN-001 | Check ID fan, aux drive, shell scanner, CO analyzer, emergency power, diesel supply. | All healthy. | SP-34 | Show failed items. Stay in step. | T1, T2 |
| 2 / FR-KLN-002 | Start M-KLN-102 and SQ-T. | Aux drive running, ZS-KLN-102 engaged. | SP-35 | Alarm AL-10. Block step 3. | T1, T2 |
| 3 / FR-KLN-003 | Start the ID fan. Go to SP-10. | Speed at or above SP-07 and stable. | SP-36 | Hold. Alarm AL-03. | T1, T2 |
| 4 / FR-KLN-004 | Purge at SP-10. | Purge time SP-11 complete. | SP-11 plus margin | Restart the purge. | T1, T2 |
| 5 / FR-KLN-005 | Prompt P-01 (ignition readiness). | Operator confirms. | SP-34 | Go to ST-08. | T3 |

### SQ-2 Diesel firing and heat-up (ST-03)

| Step / ID | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response | Test |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 / FR-KLN-010 | Operator pushes FIRE. Open FV-BRN-101 to SP-25. | BS-BRN-101 proves flame. | SP-26 | Close FV-BRN-101. Alarm AL-12. Latch. Require a new purge. | T1, T2 |
| 2 / FR-KLN-011 | Initialize the ramp SP to the TT-KLN-101 PV. Ramp at SP-02. Keep the ID fan at or above SP-07. | TT-KLN-101 at or above SP-01. | SP-37 | Go to ST-08. Prompt P-02. | T1, T2 |

### SQ-3 Coal changeover (ST-04)

| Step / ID | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response | Test |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 / FR-KLN-020 | Check coal ready, CO below SP-12, TT-KLN-101 at or above SP-01. | All true. | SP-34 | Stay in ST-03. Show failed items. | T1, T2 |
| 2 / FR-KLN-021 | Operator pushes COAL. Start FIC-BRN-102 at SP-27. | Coal flame proven. | SP-38 | Stop coal. Keep diesel on. Alarm AL-12. Go to ST-08. | T1, T2 |
| 3 / FR-KLN-022 | Raise coal and lower diesel in steps of SP-28 every SP-29. Hold the total fuel demand. | FV-BRN-101 closed. | SP-39 | Return diesel to the last good value. Go to ST-08. | T1, T2 |

### SQ-4 Coal heat-up and feed start (ST-05, ST-06)

| Step / ID | Action | Transition condition | Timeout | Failure response | Test |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 / FR-KLN-030 | Continue the ramp at SP-02 on coal. | Feed permissives true (FR-KLN-040). | SP-40 | Go to ST-08. Prompt P-02. | T1, T2 |
| 2 / FR-KLN-031 | Prompt P-04. Operator pushes FEED. Start feed at SP-18. | Feed stable for SP-41. | SP-41 | Stop feed. Go to ST-08. | T1, T2 |
| 3 / FR-KLN-032 | Raise feed by SP-20 every SP-21 until the operator target. Total ramp time is SP-19. | Feed at target. | SP-19 plus margin | Hold the ramp. Alarm AL-15. | T1, T2 |
| 4 / FR-KLN-033 | Hand off to ST-07. | n/a | n/a | n/a | T3 |

### SQ-T Kiln turning (parallel, from ST-02)

| ID | Requirement | Test |
|---|---|---|
| FR-KLN-050 | Turn the kiln on M-KLN-102 per the turning schedule (Annex A2). The interval shortens as TT-KLN-101 rises. | T1 |
| FR-KLN-051 | If a turn is overdue by more than SP-42, raise AL-09. | T2 |
| FR-KLN-052 | At TT-KLN-101 at or above SP-31, prompt P-03. After the operator confirms, start M-KLN-101 at SP-30 only when ZS-KLN-102 shows the aux drive disengaged. | T1, T3 |
| FR-KLN-053 | If M-KLN-101 does not start in SP-35, re-engage the aux drive. Resume the schedule. Alarm AL-10. | T2 |

## 6. Interlocks and permissives

No cause-and-effect chart was given, so the rows are written here. The fuel trip and the ESP CO trip are expected to be SIS functions. The SRS (not in this document) owns the trip logic and values. The BPCS behavior is below.

| ID | Cause | Effect | Latched or auto-reset | Reset |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-KLN-040 | Feed start permissive. All of these must be true: TT-KLN-101 at or above SP-16, TT-KLN-102 at or above SP-17, ID fan at or above SP-07, CO below SP-12, TI-KLN-201 healthy and below SP-24, M-KLN-101 running at or above SP-30, feed system ready. | Allow FEED. | Auto | Auto |
| FR-KLN-041 | ID fan speed below SP-07 for SP-09 while firing | Trip diesel valve and coal feeder. Stop feed. Go to ST-09. Keep the kiln turning. | Latched | ID fan above SP-08, new purge, operator reset |
| FR-KLN-042 | CO at or above SP-13 | Trip ESP-101 HV. Hold the ramp. Block fuel increase. | Latched | CO below SP-14 for SP-15, operator reset |
| FR-KLN-043 | AT-KLN-101 bad PV | Same effect as FR-KLN-042 (fail safe). | Latched | Analyzer healthy, operator reset |
| FR-KLN-044 | Ramp rate above SP-05 | Cut fuel. Freeze the ramp SP. | Auto | Rate below SP-04 |
| FR-KLN-045 | TI-KLN-201 at or above SP-24 | Stop feed. Cut fuel to the low-fire minimum. Keep the kiln turning. Prompt P-05. | Latched | Operator reset |
| FR-KLN-046 | TT-KLN-101 below SP-22 during feed ramp | Stop feed. Go to ST-08. | Latched | Operator reset |
| FR-KLN-047 | Feed running and ID fan, coal flame or main drive lost | Stop feed. Go to ST-08. | Auto | Cause cleared, operator resumes |

---

## 7. Alarms

No alarm database was given. Priorities are provisional.

| ID | Condition | Priority | Response |
|---|---|---|---|
| AL-01 | Ramp rate above SP-04 | High | Check fuel. See FR-KLN-044. |
| AL-02 | Ramp rate below SP-03 for SP-43 | Medium | Check fuel and air. Prompt P-02. |
| AL-03 | ID fan speed below SP-08 | High | Raise fan speed. |
| AL-04 | CO at or above SP-12 | High | Hold fuel increase. Check the flame. |
| AL-05 | ESP tripped on CO | Critical | See FR-KLN-042. |
| AL-06 | AT-KLN-101 bad PV or comms | Critical | See FR-KLN-043. |
| AL-07 | TI-KLN-201 at or above SP-23 | High | Inspect the zone. Hold the ramp. |
| AL-08 | TI-KLN-201 at or above SP-24 | Critical | See FR-KLN-045. |
| AL-09 | Kiln turn overdue | High | Check the aux drive. |
| AL-10 | Drive fault | Critical | Turn the kiln by hand. Prompt P-06. |
| AL-11 | Emergency power not available | High | Fix before firing. Pre-start blocks. |
| AL-12 | Ignition failure | High | See FR-KLN-010, FR-KLN-021. |
| AL-13 | TT-KLN-101 bad PV | High | See Section 8. |
| AL-14 | Shell scanner fault or comms loss | High | Section 8. Block feed start. |
| AL-15 | Sequence step timeout | Medium | Go to ST-08. |

---

## 8. Abnormal handling

| ID | Condition | Required behavior | Test |
|---|---|---|---|
| FR-KLN-060 | TT-KLN-101 bad PV | Freeze the ramp and the fuel. Alarm AL-13. Do not advance. After SP-44, go to ST-08. | T1, T2 |
| FR-KLN-061 | Shell scanner or comms loss | Alarm AL-14. Block feed start. Prompt manual inspection. Continue firing. | T1 |
| FR-KLN-062 | Main power loss | Fuel, feed and ID fan stop. Go to ST-09. M-KLN-102 starts automatically within SP-33 on emergency power. Turn the kiln per the schedule. Do not stop turning. | T1 |
| FR-KLN-063 | Power return | Do not relight automatically. Prompt P-07. Pick the restart entry by TT-KLN-101: below SP-01 start at ST-03, from SP-01 to below SP-16 start at ST-04 (relight on diesel first), at or above SP-16 relight and go to ST-06 when the permissives are true. Always purge. | T1, T3 |
| FR-KLN-064 | Controller restart | Assume the kiln has been stopped for an unknown time. Turn the kiln at once. Run the schedule from the current band. | T1 |
| FR-KLN-065 | Main drive trip | Start M-KLN-102 within SP-33 and resume the schedule. | T1 |
| FR-KLN-066 | Aux drive fails and the kiln is stopped above SP-32 | Trip fuel. Alarm AL-10. Prompt P-06 (manual turning). | T1 |

**Fail positions:**

| Device | Position on loss of signal or power |
|---|---|
| FV-BRN-101 | Closed |
| FIC-BRN-102 | Stopped |
| FIC-KLN-101 | Stopped |
| SC-ID-101 | Hold last speed (confirm) |
| ESP-101 | HV off |
| M-KLN-102 | Starts on emergency power |

---

## 9. Operator interface

| ID | Requirement | Test |
|---|---|---|
| FR-KLN-070 | Show the state, step, and time in step. | T3 |
| FR-KLN-071 | Show TT-KLN-101 PV, ramp SP, and rate. | T3 |
| FR-KLN-072 | Show every permissive with pass or fail. | T3 |
| FR-KLN-073 | Show the next turn time and the drive in use. | T3 |
| FR-KLN-074 | Show ID fan speed, CO, TI-KLN-201 maximum and its zone, and feed. | T3 |
| FR-KLN-075 | Operator may change the ramp rate only between SP-03 and SP-04. Operator may HOLD, RESUME, or ABORT. Operator sets the feed target. | T3 |
| FR-KLN-076 | Operations must sign off all states and prompts before FAT. | Doc review |

**Prompts** (warning first, then reason):

| ID | Text |
|---|---|
| P-01 | Check the diesel supply. Confirm the burner position. Push CONFIRM. |
| P-02 | Check fuel and air. The heat-up rate is out of range. |
| P-03 | Push CONFIRM to change to the main drive. The aux drive disengages first. |
| P-04 | Check the shell scanner. Hot spots can damage the shell. Push FEED to start the feed. |
| P-05 | Inspect the hot zone. Do not stop the kiln, because a stopped hot kiln can bow. |
| P-06 | Turn the kiln by hand now. A stopped hot kiln can bow. |
| P-07 | Make sure the ID fan is running. Make sure the purge is complete. Then push RELIGHT. |

## Checks

- **Complete:** Every requirement has an ID and a test method. Every sequence step has a timeout and a failure response. Bad PV, comms loss, power loss, restart and fail positions are defined.
- **Not yet verified:** Most Annex A values are my proposals, not the operator's. Annex A marks which are not from the notes.
- **Not applied yet:** I did an STE pass on the prompts and requirement text, but I did not do a sentence-by-sentence length check of the full text.
- **Safety:** The ESP CO trip and fuel trip are SIS functions. This section states the BPCS behavior only. Do not release the CO and ID-fan values until the SRS owner confirms them.
- **Capture before retirement:** Open items 1, 2 and 8 depend on the operator's knowledge. Schedule those sessions first.
